record.question: Who is responsible to conduct inquest when death in prison, dowry death, police custody and exhumation when the cause of death is questionable?
record.explanation: Answer C: District Magistrate. In India, deaths in police custody/prison and certain other suspicious circumstances trigger a magistrate inquest under criminal procedure; the District Magistrate is the closest listed authority, though the statute also authorizes other magistrates. Source/context note: Statutory wording permits an empowered magistrate; “District Magistrate” is not the only magistrate who may be authorized. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/1524?view_type=browse. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
